_source_notes.shot_clock.enabled: PERMANENT PRODUCT DECISION (owner, P6, 2026-09-13): CSRN basketball broadcasts never track or display a shot clock, full stop -- this is not conditioned on what MHSAA's actual on-court rule turns out to be. Running one accurately live is operationally impractical for a broadcast crew, and CSRN doesn't officiate the game anyway. enabled=false here is final, not a placeholder pending handbook lookup; do not revisit this pending 'confirmation.' The engine's shot-clock state fields and the overlay serializer's blank-when-off behavior stay in place regardless -- they cost nothing to keep dormant, and another ruleset/consumer of this engine may want them on someday.
_source_notes.fouls.bonus_rule: Using the NFHS-generic default (5th-team-foul/two-shot/quarter-scope), not independently confirmed for MHSAA specifically (owner, P6, 2026-09-13: not worth chasing the exact handbook wording for a broadcast-only product). Revisit only if this ever turns out to matter for broadcast accuracy -- e.g. an operator reports CSRN's displayed bonus status visibly disagreeing with the referees' own call on air.
_source_notes.timeouts: Using the NFHS-generic allotment (3 full + 2 short, 1 carrying into OT), not independently confirmed for MHSAA specifically (owner, P6, 2026-09-13: not worth chasing the exact handbook wording for a broadcast-only product). Revisit only if this ever turns out to matter for broadcast accuracy.
_source_notes.defaults.timezone: America/Chicago is Mississippi's actual timezone -- a plain geographic fact, not a rules-book value requiring confirmation, included here for parity with football/us-ms-mhsaa.json's own defaults.timezone convention.
